children: K&F Growth Acquisition II said the transfer of its listing to the Nasdaq Capital Market resolved a prior shareholder count deficiency.
Received Nasdaq notice for noncompliance with Rule 5450(a)(2) requiring 400 total holders.
Submitted application to transfer from Nasdaq Global Market to Nasdaq Capital Market on Aug 26, 2026.
Transfer was granted Sep 14, 2026 and became effective Sep 16, 2026.
As a result of the transfer, the total-holder deficiency was rendered moot.
